scope.memory_measurement: MLX allocator peak active; not process RSS or physical peak

gpu_profile.clock_mapping: mach_absolute_time * numerator / denominator; Python macOS perf_counter monotonic window
gpu_profile.gpu_time_scope: union of target-PID depth-zero Active Compute intervals; nested/unrelated work excluded
gpu_profile.shader_time_scope: Instruments Shader Timeline sampled durations, intersected with target-PID workload; shares use summed sampled time, not GPU wall time; fused dequantization cannot be separated
gpu_profile.trace_sha256_scope: per-file inventory; local diagnostic trace is retained outside versioned evidence
gpu_profile.profiler_overhead: timings are instrumented; E2E selection uses separate unprofiled HTTP workers
